children.description: Number of child processes to spawn

timeout.description: Seconds to wait on DNS response

buffer.description: Maximum number of log lines to keep in memory

flush.description: Number of lines to process before flushing output buffer

cache_file.description: Filename to use as disk cache. Empty string means none.

ttl.description: Number of seconds before IPs cached on disk are expired

regex.description: Perl regular expression to match IP
